scope.session_a: Fresh opening plus15 player turns, root-driven; training, refusal of an extension, quiet days, petition progress and a complete game. The final input is an in-character complaint about the game's running commentary, not a changed system prompt.
scope.session_b: Fresh opening plus15 player turns, independent player driver from public story and persona only. No root follow-up or16 dispatched. Exact driver notes retained.
scope.family_replay: Three supplementary replies: matched C17 B05 input after its visible00-04 history, then two adaptive family questions. This is not a fresh long session or a controlled API replay.

strengths.letter_stimulus: Clarifying the letter's ordinary occasion produces specific correspondence about a planned visit, food, boots or a folio, instead of instructions to a future heir. The family replay gives Tomas's cancelled visit, a later visit by Miriam, portrait-label corrections and poor tea. A6 gives Marian's letter to Elias about three nights in the blue room. B's Lenora/Willan branch is a different fresh canon. These additions are permitted history, not failures merely because they are new.
strengths.session_a: The NPC petition dispute has actual replies and continues without Rowan's signature (A1-3, A11). Ashara preserves her own training hour, completes it, gives the offered ten-minute lesson, leaves Rowan a beginner and refuses both an offered payment and a second appeal for more time (A7-10). Rowan's quiet two-day routine permits submission of the revised request. Thessaly repeats an invitation after an earlier decline, completes a game4-2, and responds to a social complaint by apologizing and offering tea (A11-15).
strengths.session_b: Rashid asks Rowan to read the actual petition and gains a voluntarily submitted signature and interest in future practice (B2-7). Stone's promised lookup yields family relationships and an old address; Rowan authors a letter, and Stone prepares a sealed inquiry without rewriting it (B9-11). Ysolde's sunset plan happens, her mistaken first interpretation of the light gives her interest a personal origin, and the visit becomes shared tea (B12-15). These quiet outcomes need no imposed conspiracy revelation.

failure: Too many people still sound like instructors delivering prepared conclusions. A14 is decisive: bad moves belong to their owner; a road cannot exist just because the player wants it; the former opponent's satisfying theory does not improve the board; close roads rarely stay open. This is a succession of maxims around a completed game. Ashara's sensible refusal turns into a claim that more practice would teach dependence (A10). Stone repeatedly frames ordinary information against imagined expectations of grandeur, including families looking dramatic from afar, the real person versus a lawyer's title, and what a letter must promise (B5, B9-10). Faculty speeches can reasonably be instructional, and individual jokes or insights can work; the repeated register across unrelated people is the problem. Ysolde's personal weather observation and the revised letters are better, but do not repair the whole-session pattern.

boundaries.verdict: No demonstrated unresolved material authorship or inaccessible-knowledge failure. Preserve the listed ambiguities rather than treating the prose as exact mechanical verification.
boundaries.private_knowledge: A7's Jory Hale comparison remains unavailable to NPCs through the later exchanges. The narrator unnecessarily restates that it remains unspoken, a prose weakness. No hidden plague cause, patronage, ward solution or magical awakening is disclosed.
boundaries.authorship: A7-8 expressly delegate observation and ten minutes of coached practice. A14 delegates the complete game and strategy. A8's coach saying 'No apology' may read as an anticipatory instruction; no actual unsubmitted protagonist apology is narrated. B11's personal letter is entirely supplied by the player and is not rewritten. The player's smiles, feeling about the room, cold and tea invitation are explicit in B's inputs.
boundaries.timing: The first private training hour and additional ten-minute offer are fulfilled, and the additional request is refused; the prose does not establish an absolute rule forbidding all post-booking presence. The two-day routine's ending returns to the second dinner's game invitation after summarizing practice each night; the endpoint staging is loose, not a demonstrated new voluntary choice imposed on Rowan. The report and full court reopening remain unresolved.
boundaries.history_dates: B10 calls an address68 years old and seven years before the collapse, while the brief places the plague60 years ago. Taken as exact single-event dates this is a one-year discrepancy. The terms and approximate year precision are not resolved here; do not invent an observed separate collapse date as evidence. This is a chronology concern, not a new-history prohibition. Ysolde's reference to her first term does not establish an impossible earlier school history: being a first-year Conclave student does not itself fix all earlier attendance or the number of terms already elapsed.
boundaries.game: A12's card omits movement distance and entry conventions; A13 supplies them after the player asks. The demonstration's new-road/center wording is imprecise. A14 ends explicitly with all four amber returned, two blue returned and another blue near an exit. The fourth blue is not located. The prose supports a completed game but is not a verified full legal move trace.
boundaries.delivery: B's driver made one harmless duplicated-path read at08, corrected before reading the intended passage. No other-session context exposure or author redelivery was reported. B0 stages the coat on a chair despite the persona's wearing description; the driver explicitly puts it on in B1. This is a small initial staging mismatch.
